concept: Free-form tags typed into one groove, each becoming a removable chip, for labels the reader makes up.

default_to_avoid.pattern: a comma-separated text field (tags: a, b, c) or a field with blue pills as the tag input
default_to_avoid.kind: tag input, tags field, token field, chips input
default_to_avoid.why_not: a comma list cannot be edited one tag at a time; blue pills bring a hue

derivation.consequence: light falls from above, so every surface carries a rim brightest along its top edge and a soft shadow below that says where it floats, and a recess is the inverse, shaded under its top lip and lit on its bottom lip; a nested surface adds no second blur, because one sheet of glass is one layer
derivation.form: the field is Input’s groove; tags are Chips inside it, the system’s removable value

derivation.consequence: keyboard reaches everything a pointer can, with a visible focus ring on any backdrop
derivation.form: Enter or a comma adds, Backspace removes the last, each chip has a remove button with its own name

derivation.consequence: secondary text keeps the lowest opacity that still measured as passing; text halos count only where WCAG allows them
derivation.form: a hint under the field says how to add a tag

variants.reason: A uses Chip, editable one tag at a time. B is one string to edit. C brings a hue.

root.why: the label, field and hint with the field gap

label.why: the field’s label, its accessible name, the same in every theme and on every scene

field.why: a groove holding chips and the text, wrapping as it fills

input.why: the typing space, a 44px target, the same in every theme and on every scene

hint.why: how to add a tag, in secondary text

focus-within.why: the field shows the focus ring while typing

disabled.why: the input is disabled when the maximum is reached

@media forced-colors: active.why: forced colours outline the field, the same in every theme and on every scene

aria-invalid=true.why: a wrong answer takes the critical ring a field takes, and FormField says what is wrong in words

data-off.why: an off field dims its whole groove and refuses typing, so it reads as not available
